visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a mobile game interface displaying the 'Evolution/Degeneration' path for a Digimon. A small white creature with pink ears, Tokomon, is the focus on a digital grid background. A real man's head is overlaid in the bottom left, looking upward with a curious expression. Yellow Chinese text '進化/退化' is visible at the top. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of Tokomon, its red eyes wide and mouth open. The background is a bright, abstract digital space with glowing cubes. A brilliant white light then consumes the screen as digital particles disperse. The lighting is extremely bright and high-contrast, representing a transformation sequence. (3) After the light fades, a yellow bipedal dinosaur, Agumon, is revealed standing on a circular glowing platform. The setting is a digital void filled with floating cubes and light lines. The camera pans slightly around the character. Text appears saying '進化畫面。信了' indicating the viewer's reaction. (4) The scene transitions to a cinematic anime cutscene. A girl wearing a white cat-themed hoodie looks startled in a dark, urban environment. Several small purple and gray Digimon stand on a train track in a tunnel. Informative text boxes appear at the bottom with dialogue in Chinese. (5) A gameplay selection screen appears where the player chooses between different Digimon. Various icons and stat bars are visible. The environment shifts to a dark cave where a girl walks alongside a massive black Greymon-like creature with glowing red eyes. The lighting is dim with red highlights. (6) A montage of fast-paced combat scenes follows. Various Digimon execute special moves involving fire, claws, and projectiles. The backgrounds vary from city rooftops to digital arenas. Status bars and damage numbers float above the characters. Variety-show style captions like '角色好香' appear. (7) The video concludes with a dramatic evolution into a powerful knight-like Digimon, Omegamon, in a ruined urban landscape. The camera uses dynamic angles and rapid cuts to emphasize the scale of the battle. Bright energy flashes and particle effects dominate the final frames.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An upbeat, high-tempo J-Pop background music track starts immediately. A distinct digital 'click' sound effect is heard as a menu item is selected. The male speaker's voice is heard in the background with a low, impressed tone, speaking in Mandarin. (2) A sharp, resonant digital 'ping' or stinger sound occurs simultaneously with the visual light flash. The music tempo remains constant, but the spectral brightness increases significantly. The male speaker lets out a soft vocalization of awe. (3) The music transitions into a more rhythmic section with a strong drum beat. A female Japanese voice actor's lines are heard, delivering dialogue with a determined and serious tone. The ambient noise floor is clean, suggesting a studio-produced mix. (4) A series of rapid 'whoosh' and 'thud' sound effects trigger as combat begins on screen. Each effect has a wide spectral bandwidth. The male commentator speaks again, his voice pitch rising and speech rate increasing, showing high arousal and excitement. (5) A loud, mechanical 'roar' sound effect occurs when a large black creature appears. The BGM maintains its energetic pace. Vocal overlays from the anime characters include short shouts and gasps, with high articulation clarity. (6) The audio density peaks during the final battle montage. Overlapping sounds of energy blasts, metallic clashing, and explosions are layered over the driving rock-style BGM. The music and speech have a balanced loudness ratio throughout this sequence. (7) A dramatic orchestral swell with synthesizers marks the final evolution. A lingering, high-frequency 'shimmer' effect trails off as the video ends. The overall dynamic range is compressed to maintain a high-energy broadcast feel.
